header.title: FAB
header.description: Floating action button: a round button pinned to a corner, above the content, for the main action of the screen (create, compose, add). It uses `position="fixed"` by default and anchors to the bottom right of the viewport. With `actions` it becomes a speed dial that fans out related actions. Use only one per screen; if you have several actions of equal weight, regular buttons in the UI work better.

demo.hint: Demos use position="absolute" so the FAB stays inside this box. In an app, keep the default fixed and it anchors to the viewport.

playground.title: Playground
playground.description: Adjust the props and see the result. The preview uses `position="absolute"` inside a container with `position: relative`. `actionVariant` and `transition` only apply when there are `actions`.

base.title: Basic usage
base.description: An icon-only FAB. Since it has no visible text, always pass a translated `aria-label`: otherwise it is announced as "Quick action". If you omit `icon`, it shows a `+`.

extended.title: Extended
extended.description: With `label` the button becomes a pill with icon and text. When `label` is a string it is also the accessible name, so `aria-label` is not needed. Useful when the icon alone does not explain the action.

tones.title: Tones
tones.description: `tone` sets the color from the gem-system palette. The default is `primary`. `tertiary` and `warning` use dark text to keep contrast. Shown here with `position="static"` to line them up.

sizes.title: Sizes
sizes.description: `size` can be `sm` (40px), `md` (56px, default) or `lg` (64px). It also changes the size of the speed dial actions.

placements.title: Corners
placements.description: `placement` picks the corner and `offset` the distance to the edges in pixels (default `24`). `offset` also accepts `{ x, y }` to set each axis. The `-start` and `-end` corners follow the text direction.

speedDial.title: Speed dial
speedDial.description: With `actions` the FAB fans out related actions. Each action has an `id`, `icon` and `label`, and can have its own `tone`. `onAction` receives the chosen `id` and, by default, the menu closes after each action. Escape or a click outside closes it, and arrow keys move focus between actions.

direction.title: Direction
direction.description: Actions open upward when the FAB is at the bottom and downward when it is at the top. With `direction` you can open them sideways (`start` or `end`), useful on short screens. Sideways, `showActionLabels={false}` keeps the labels from overlapping.

custom.title: Surface chips and tooltips
custom.description: `actionVariant="surface"` shows the actions as light chips instead of the FAB color. `transition="opacity"` fades them in with a stagger, and `showActionLabels={false}` swaps the side labels for tooltips. This demo starts open with `defaultOpen`.

share.title: Link copied
share.description: Anyone with the link can view this record.

print.title: Sent to printer
print.description: The document is in the print queue.

copy.title: Copied
copy.description: The selection is on the clipboard.

customIcon.title: Open icon
customIcon.description: `icon` is the icon of the closed button and `openIcon` the one shown while the speed dial is open. Without `openIcon`, the icon rotates 45° (the `+` turns into an ×).

controlled.title: Controlled
controlled.description: With `open` and `onOpenChange` you manage the state from outside, for example to open it from another button. With `closeOnAction={false}` the menu stays open after picking an action.

onCard.title: On a card
onCard.description: With `position="absolute"` the FAB anchors to the nearest positioned container instead of the viewport. Set `position: relative` on the container and lower the `offset` so it sits on the card corner.

texts.title: Field notes
texts.subtitle: Draft
texts.body: Add a new observation without leaving the card. The FAB sits on the corner of this container.

loading.title: Loading
loading.description: `isLoading` replaces the icon with a spinner and disables the button, so it is not submitted twice. Press the second button to see the change.

disabled.title: Disabled
disabled.description: `disabled` lowers the opacity and blocks clicks. If the action is unavailable for a while, consider hiding the FAB instead of leaving it disabled.

header.title: FAB API
header.description: API reference for the Fab React component: props, speed dial actions, CSS classes, CSS variables, tokens and exported types.

demos.title: Demos
demos.description: For examples and usage details, visit the component demos page.

import.title: Import
import.description: You can import it from the main entry or from its subpath. The value lists (`FAB_TONES`, `FAB_SIZES`, `FAB_PLACEMENTS`, etc.) are only exported from the subpath.

inheritance.title: Inheritance
inheritance.body: Accepts the HTML attributes of a <button> (ButtonHTMLAttributes<HTMLButtonElement>) and passes them to the main button, like ref. The exception is className, which goes to the root container. classNames adds classes to each part: root, trigger, icon, label, spinner, actions, action, actionIcon and actionLabel.

a11y.title: Accessibility
a11y.name: The accessible name is aria-label or, when missing, label if it is a string. An icon-only FAB needs aria-label.
a11y.menu: With actions, the button gets aria-haspopup="menu", aria-expanded and aria-controls, and the action list has role="menu".
a11y.keyboard: Arrow up or down on the button opens the speed dial and focuses an action. Arrow keys, Home and End move focus between actions, and Tab closes the menu.
a11y.dismiss: Escape closes the speed dial and returns focus to the button. A click outside also closes it.
a11y.hidden: While closed, the action list is inert and aria-hidden, so it cannot be focused.
a11y.tooltips: With showActionLabels={false} each action uses its label (or ariaLabel) as its accessible name and shows it in a tooltip.
a11y.loading: isLoading adds aria-busy and disables the button. The spinner is decorative.
a11y.labels: Default names are in English ("Quick action", "Open actions" and "Close actions"). Pass a translated aria-label in other languages.

cssClasses.title: CSS classes
cssClasses.description: Classes you can use to override styles.

rules.root: Root container. Receives `className` and `classNames.root` and defines the FAB variables.
rules.tone: Colors for each `tone`. Sets `--gem-fab-bg`, `--gem-fab-fg`, `--gem-fab-border` and their hover variants.
rules.size: Size of the button and the actions.
rules.extended: Applied when there is a `label` and the button is a pill.
rules.open: Applied while the speed dial is open.
rules.rotate: Rotates the icon 45° when open. Not applied with `openIcon` or `label`.
rules.label: Text of the extended version. Receives `classNames.label`.
rules.actionItem: Row of each action, with the button and the label.
rules.action: Round button of each action. Receives `classNames.action`.
rules.actionTone: Colors of an action based on its `tone`.
rules.actionLabel: Side label of the action. Receives `classNames.actionLabel`.

cssVariables.title: CSS variables
cssVariables.description: Defined on `.gem-fab` and on the tone and size classes. To change them, use a more specific selector such as `.gem-fab.my-class`. `--gem-fab-inset-x` and `--gem-fab-inset-y` are written inline from `offset`, and `--gem-fab-count` and `--gem-fab-stagger` are inline too.

items.--gem-fab-size: Size of the main button (height in the extended version).
items.--gem-fab-action-size: Size of each speed dial action.
items.--gem-fab-fg-hover: Icon and text color on hover.
items.--gem-fab-inset-x: Distance to the horizontal edge. Inline from `offset`.
items.--gem-fab-inset-y: Distance to the vertical edge. Inline from `offset`.
items.--gem-fab-count: Number of actions. Inline, used to stagger the animation.
items.--gem-fab-stagger: Index of each action. Inline, sets its animation delay.

items.--gem-palette-*: Colors for each `tone` (shades 500 to 700 depending on the color) and their dark theme variants.
items.--gem-radius-full: Round shape of the button and the actions.
items.--gem-radius-sm: Corner of the action side labels.
items.--gem-space-2: Gap between icon and text, and between actions.
items.--gem-space-3: Padding of the extended version and the side labels.
items.--gem-color-bg: Background of `surface` actions and side labels.

types.title: Exported types
types.description: Available from @gem-org/gem-system to type your own wrappers.

props.title: Props
props.description: Props of the FAB and of each speed dial action.

fab.title: Fab
fab.description: It also accepts the HTML attributes of a `<button>`.

items.icon: Button icon. If omitted, uses `children` or a `+`.
items.label: Text next to the icon. Turns it into a pill and, if it is a string, is the accessible name.
items.aria-label: Accessible name. Required when there is no `label`. Without it, it reads `"Quick action"` or `"Open actions"` / `"Close actions"`.
items.size: Size of the button and the actions.
items.position: `fixed` anchors it to the viewport, `absolute` to the positioned container and `static` keeps it in the flow.
items.placement: Corner it anchors to with `fixed` or `absolute`.
items.offset: Distance to the edges in pixels. A number applies to both axes.
items.actions: Speed dial actions. When set, the button opens and closes the menu instead of running an action.
items.direction: Where the actions open. Defaults to `up` at the bottom and `down` at the top.
items.actionVariant: `tone` uses the FAB color on the actions; `surface` shows them as light chips.
items.transition: Action animation: `scale`, or `opacity` with a staggered fade.
items.showActionLabels: Shows labels next to the actions. With `false` it uses tooltips.
items.closeOnAction: Closes the speed dial after picking an action.
items.openIcon: Icon while the speed dial is open. Without it, the icon rotates 45°.
items.isLoading: Shows a spinner and disables the button.
items.className: Classes for the root container (not the button).
items.onClick: Runs when the button is clicked. With `actions` it also opens or closes the menu.
items.onOpenChange: Runs when the speed dial opens or closes.
items.onAction: Runs with the `id` of the chosen action.

items.id: Unique identifier. It is the value `onAction` receives.
items.label: Visible text next to it (or in the tooltip). Also the accessible name.
items.ariaLabel: Accessible name when `label` should be visual only.
items.tone: Action color. If omitted, uses the FAB `tone`, or the light chip with `actionVariant="surface"`.
items.onClick: Runs when the action is picked, before `onAction`.
